synopsis: ISO 20474-1:2017 and its machine-specific Parts 2 to 15 provide baseline safety requirements for earth-moving machinery, as stated consistently in Chapter 3 and the glossary [f2189, f15241, f2711]. Chapter 3 describes this as a published, current international standards family covering both general and machine-specific safety [f2710]. Collision avoidance is not its specialised purpose, and it does not provide a collision-avoidance protocol or serve as the acceptance standard for automatic braking [f2190, f2711]. For acceptance planning, the corpus positions this family alongside ISO 21815 and ISO 19014, rather than as a substitute for collision-mitigation-specific acceptance criteria [f2190].

relations.note: Glossary and Chapter 3 restate the baseline earth-moving machinery safety role.
Chapter 3 adds that baseline safety requirements are not a collision-avoidance protocol.
Adds published, current international status and general versus machine-specific coverage.
Adds automatic-braking acceptance limits and positioning alongside ISO 21815 and ISO 19014.
Adds the explicit exclusion of a collision-avoidance protocol to the baseline safety role.
